about: PROPOSAL (worker claude2, 3/10/2026), not adopted: line groups for the expanded corpus, in the schema of reports/modelli/rete_cellulare_2026-10-03/line_groups.json (contexts, study_prefixes), which it contains unchanged. R-LEAD owns P1: it adopts or corrects this with a new file. Resolution is cell_data.group_of without its fallback: a (study, context) with no rule is refused by coverage_audit.py, never a silent new group. 'related' lists groups removed together with a held-out group when strictness is wanted (shared donor or line family); 'evidence' says where each new rule comes from and what is unverified.

evidence.unchanged from the pilot: H1, K562, A549, KOLF2.1J iPSC, Jurkat, RPE1, HepG2, iPSC-induced neuron, Hs27, prefix hipsci_ (reports/modelli/rete_cellulare_2026-10-03/line_groups.json)
evidence.bench groups (R-LEAD registry.py): CD4T, HCT116, HEK293T, iPSC with KOLF2.1J, K562 with Replogle and VIPerturb
evidence.HEK293 -> HEK293T: Xu 2023 HEK293 kept in the HEK293T family as in ruoli_ingestione_r1.json; HEK293T derives from HEK293: not an independent context (inference from the line names, not a measurement)
evidence.dixit2016_, norman2019_ -> K562: contexts 'K562 day 7', 'K562 day 13', 'K562 high MOI' of J15 (wave3_specs.py); time and MOI are states of one line
evidence.datlinger2017_, datlinger2021_ -> Jurkat: spec labels of wave3_specs.py; contexts are 'stimulated'/'unstimulated'. UNVERIFIED in the shards: INGESTIONE.md §4 asks to read the 2021 context before fixing the role; Jurkat is the conservative choice (it creates no new group)
evidence.frangieh2021_ -> Melanoma_Frangieh2021: contexts Control, IFNγ, Co-culture are three states of one melanoma line (smoke_w3/j13_scp_ko_r1_labels.json); as contexts they would have become three false groups
evidence.shifrut2018_ -> PrimaryT_Shifrut2018: primary T cells of two donors, stimulated or not (smoke_w3/j14). The T subset is UNVERIFIED here, hence 'related' to CD4T
evidence.Calu-3, THP-1: Sunshine 2023 and Papalexi 2021 arrayed (J13): new lines, KO
evidence.iPSC, iPSC-induced neuron day 7: Tian 2019 (J11), left out of the pilot (unfiltered droplets). The iPSC group is by cell type as in the bench (it already joins ten HipSci donors); the donor of the Tian lines is UNVERIFIED here, hence Neuron related to iPSC
evidence.mixscale_jiang2025_<line>: the Seurat objects hold several lines per stimulus: the adapter writes one study id per line, so a prefix names the group; the line labels are UNVERIFIED until the inspection reads them
evidence.MCF7, HT29, HAP1, BxPC3, DLD-1: listed for completeness; no cell of them is ingested
